responseText: {"verdict":"revised","findings":["W010: The draft describes 'looped teeth' and a 'wide band' of teeth; the anchor image shows individual rounded tooth shapes in a row, not a wide band. Corrected to 'a row of rounded white tooth shapes'. The draft also says 'white space remains around parts of the head' — the anchor confirms open white ground, retained.","W023: The draft describes 'two spiral forms side by side' and 'zigzag rows forming M and W shapes'. The anchor image shows two large coiled spiral/scroll forms on a yellow field with a hard red band, and the zigzag-like marks are visible above and below. However the draft calls the lower portion 'pale ground with loose colored loops' — the anchor shows the lower area is dominated by black masses with green, purple and other loose marks on a darker ground, not pale. Corrected.","W024: The draft describes 'two open-mouthed forms with visible tooth rows in the upper half'. The anchor image shows one smaller open-mouthed form at upper left and a larger darker rectangular head-like form at center with a wide open mouth and teeth; the description of 'two snarling open mouths' is broadly supported. The 'red heart in the lower right' is confirmed. The 'grey-brown ground' is confirmed. The 'red cup-like form lower left' is visible. Description retained with minor tightening.","W012: The draft describes 'a large rounded form tilts backward at center, its upper surface lit in yellow-gold against a deep black void'. Checking sheet 2, W012 shows a hooded or cloaked figure-like dark form against a warm orange-brown field — there is no clearly visible 'pale gold form arching back into blackness' nor a 'hot orange field with grid overlay'. The image appears to show a dark shrouded form against a warm amber-orange ground with diagonal hatching. The 'black void' claim is not supported; the background is warm amber-orange throughout. Corrected to remove 'black void' and 'pale gold form arching back'.","W001: The draft describes 'a dark densely layered central form rises against a flat saturated yellow ground with sharp upward spikes'. Sheet 2 confirms a dark central mass on a saturated yellow ground with a figure-like form and what appears to be a crown or spike shape at top. A 'cool green-yellow glow' at the midsection is plausible. The description of 'scattered scribble clusters' on the yellow field is confirmed. Retained.","W029: The draft describes 'a large oval outline built from multiple concentric arcs in gold and black' against 'a flat medium-blue field'. Sheet 1 confirms a blue field with a large oval/arc structure and a thick yellow horizontal bar. The 'X-marked circle' is visible. The 'dense black-and-white vertical strokes' in the lower oval are confirmed. Retained.","W023 chapter placement: W023 is placed in the final 'Multiplication and Dissolution' chapter but the anchor image shows it is primarily a face-like form with two large spiral eyes on a yellow field — it reads more as a single compressed face than a dissolved or multiplied one. Retained with corrected description of lower area.","W011: The draft mentions 'a purple comb-like shape near the top adds a note that feels almost ceremonial' — this detail is visible in the sheet image. Retained.","W013: The draft says 'a raised hand with white-tipped fingers appears at lower left' — confirmed in sheet 1. The 'thick yellow bar cuts off the right edge' is confirmed. Retained.","W015: The draft describes 'five smaller white skull-like forms cluster the right side' — sheet 2 confirms multiple small skull forms on the right. Moving through the gallery, watch what happens when color, line, ground, and gesture all press inward at once — and what, if anything, remains recognizable at the end.","closing":"The question the gallery opened with has no clean answer here.
